resources.string: Ibona uma izinkinobho ezithile kurimothi yakho zicindezelwa futhi izinike umsebenzi wokhiye noma i-app ehlukile, futhi iqaphela ukuthi iyiphi i-app esesikrinini ukuze inkinobho efanayo isebenze ngendlela ehlukile ku-app ye-TV. Ukucindezelwa kokhiye akulokothi kugcinwe noma kuthunyelwe noma kuphi.

I-MX3 Button Mapper isebenzisa i-Accessibility Service API ye-Android ukushintsha imisebenzi yezinkinobho zerimothi yakho.

Uma ivuliwe:
• Ifunda ukucindezelwa kwezinkinobho kurimothi yakho, ukuze ikwazi ukushintsha izinkinobho ezithile ngokhiye ohlukile, ukucindezela okulandelanayo, noma ukuvula i-app
• Iqaphela igama le-app esesikrinini njengamanje, ukuze inkinobho (isb. Isiteshi phezulu/phansi) yenze okuthile okuhlukile ngaphakathi ku-app ye-TV

Ayifundi okuqukethwe isikrini, umbhalo, noma amaphasiwedi. Ukucindezelwa kokhiye namagama ama-app kusetshenziswa kule divayisi kuphela, ngesikhathi kwenzeka. Akulokothi kugcinwe (ngaphandle uma uvula amalogi okuxazulula izinkinga angezansi), futhi akulokothi kwabelwane ngakho noma kuthunyelwe ngaphandle kwedivayisi. Le app ayinakho ukufinyelela kwe-inthanethi.

Uma uvuma, i-app izosebenzisa i-%1$s ukuvula isevisi yayo yokufinyeleleka egameni lakho. Ungayivala noma nini ku-Izilungiselelo → Ukufinyeleleka.
Uhlelo lokusebenza olufakwe kule nkinobho (%1$s) alufakiwe
Ngena kuwo wonke ukhiye wokucindezela (ukuthola ukuxazulula inkinga kuphela)
Ukucindezela inkinobho yelogi efakwe kumephu kabusha (yokuxazulula inkinga kuphela)
%1$s ithokheni ye-auth yenhloso yokuqala/yokumisa (namathisela umugqa ogcwele othi ‘i-auth: XXXX’ kusukela kusikrini sezinhloso zokubuka %1$s)
Nikeza %1$s imvume, bese unika amandla le sevisi ngaphansi kokufinyelela
Ibhrendi ye-TV (ithinta ngokuqondile inkinobho ye-TV ye %1$s)
